name: shelflife-context
description: Durable context for coding agents that tracks when earlier advice goes stale. It keeps what you tell the agent and what your repository's decision records say, notices when you change your mind or finish something, and flags a recommendation for review when a fact it rested on changes. Stored locally in SQLite; judged by jev on a local model. After each turn a line above the prompt says what was saved, with undo.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Which memory to use: work, personal, a client. Each scope is kept separate and has its own rules for what gets saved.

db.title: Database
db.description: Where the memory lives. Leave it empty to use ~/.shelflife-context/memory.sqlite, which the terminal install and Codex share.

strategy.title: Selection
strategy.description: jev: jev judges the stored facts a prompt is most likely to need, as many as the hook's time allows (needs jev). rules: keyword matching only. Without jev nothing new gets saved from the conversation.

jev_command.title: jev executable
jev_command.description: Full path to jev. Leave it empty to look in ~/.local/bin/jev, then the jevmate plugin, then PATH. Whether jev runs locally on Ollama or on the hosted service is jev's own setting; /shelflife-context:setup changes it.

band.title: Line above the prompt
band.description: on: after each turn, a line above the prompt says what memory saved, held for review or didn't save, with undo. off: no line (the terminal still shows the hook's message).
